transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. Next, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them, unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Some light sensitivity is normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside should help. But significant pain with bright light, or severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some light sensitivity is normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside should help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for the vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you so much for your assistance!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Some light sensitivity is normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens." The `mild_case_advice` was also conveyed with "If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside should help." However, the `escalation_criteria` was not mentioned at all in the conversation.
